name: app-factory
description: AI Native project scaffolding factory. Initialize a project, configure tooling (lint/format/hooks/CI/deploy), analyze capabilities, recommend stack, install official skills, and generate project-specific CLAUDE.md. Supports Interactive/Auto modes, 10 preset scenarios (SaaS/AI/Electron/Chrome Extension/Blog/Admin/API/CLI/SDK), and 4 deploy platform templates (Cloudflare/Vercel/AWS/Docker). Includes upgrade mode for existing projects.
